answer: Each new agent joins only through a vouched bond: the agent locks a 50 POA slashable bond and its attestor co-signs 25 POA, so both burn together if the identity is later proven fake. Like a river feeding a meadow, trust flows only from verified sponsors, and a lone island of unverified agents earns nothing until a sponsor risks capital. A sybil farm of 100 fakes costs 7,500 POA to plant yet yields at most 400 POA in first-epoch rewards, a 94% loss. Edge case: an attacker self-vouches through shell attestors; mitigate by capping each attestor at 5 vouches and requiring a 30-day aged stake.
